footnote_text: On October 27, 2026, Issuer entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement (the "Purchase Agreement") with the purchasers signatory thereto and consummated the transactions contemplated thereunder. Pursuant to the Purchase Agreement, Issuer agreed to issue and sell to Reporting Person (i) in a registered direct offering 3,837 shares of Common Stock, $0.0001 par value per share ("Common Stock")  and (ii) in a concurrent private placement 18,262 shares of Common Stock and 22,099 accompanying common stock purchase warrants to purchase shares of Common Stock (the "Common Warrants").
